## Selected publications

These publications highlight methodological research and interdisciplinary contributions. Papers may belong to more than one research area. The complete record is available on [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3079-5855) and [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=KUzOpI4AAAAJ&hl=en).

Citation counts below are those displayed by Google Scholar on **11 September 2026**. Asterisks are retained as displayed in Scholar. Counts refer to the listed records; citations from separate preprint or duplicate records have not been added.

## Artificial Intelligence and Decision Making {#artificial-intelligence}

Machine learning, Bayesian networks, generative AI and data-driven decision support connect several strands of my research. Papers in this collection also retain their spatial-statistics or efficiency-and-productivity classification where appropriate.

- [Machine learning applied to global scale species distribution models](#global-species) — 2025.
- [Estimating production functions through additive models based on regression splines](#production-splines) — 2024.
- [An adaptation of Random Forest to estimate convex non-parametric production technologies: an empirical illustration of efficiency measurement in education](#random-forest) — 2025.
- [eat: An R Package for fitting Efficiency Analysis Trees](#eat) — 2022.
- [Estimating production technologies using multi-output adaptive constrained enveloping splines](#multi-output) — 2025.
- [BIMCV COVID-19+: a large annotated dataset of RX and CT images from COVID-19 patients](#bimcv) — 2020.
- [Bayesian Networks for the Diagnosis and Prognosis of Diseases: A Scoping Review](#bayesian-networks) — 2024.
- [Concordance Between Clinical Practice Recommendations Generated by Generative Artificial Intelligence and the Vía RICA 2026 Enhanced Recovery Guideline: A Proof-of-Concept Study Using a Closed Evidence Corpus](#ai-guidelines) — 2026.
- [A calculator for musculoskeletal injuries prediction in surgeons: a machine learning approach](#surgeon-calculator) — 2024.
- [Discovering HIV related information by means of association rules and machine learning](#hiv-ml) — 2022.
- [UMLS-ChestNet: A deep convolutional neural network for radiological findings, differential diagnoses and localizations of COVID-19 in chest x-rays](#umls) — 2020.

## Academic profile {#academic-profile}

### Education

- **PhD, 2009**, Universidad Miguel Hernández de Elche. Research on geostatistical models for bioclimatic indices, supervised by Javier Morales and Antonio López-Quílez.
- **Licenciatura in Statistical Sciences and Techniques, 2000**, Universidad Miguel Hernández de Elche.
- **Diplomatura in Statistics, 1996**, Universidad de Alicante.

### Teaching and supervision

University teaching since 2005 across statistics, econometrics, Bayesian modelling, data analysis, time series and experimental design, at undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Teaching has included programmes at UMH and Universitat de València.

Supervision of doctoral, master’s and undergraduate research in statistical modelling, environmental analysis, health sciences, and efficiency and productivity. Current research supervision includes Bayesian diagnostic modelling and spatio-temporal environmental analysis.

Teaching recognition includes **Talento Docente awards** and **Excellent evaluations in the DOCENTIA-UMH programme**.

### Research projects and knowledge transfer

Participation in regional, national and European research projects, including climate-risk modelling in aquaculture through MODESTA–ThinkInAzul, Bayesian environmental modelling, and health research. Applied work connects hospitals, public institutions and industrial partners.

Knowledge-transfer activities include statistical and machine-learning consulting, the `eat` R package, and training public administrations in generative AI, prompt engineering and responsible use of large language models.

[More about Artificial Intelligence research and knowledge transfer](xbarber.html).

### Scientific leadership

Chair of the Representative Council of the **International Biometric Society, 2026–2027**, and head of the **UMH–FISABIO Joint Research Unit on Statistical Methods in Health Sciences**. Deputy Vice-Rector for Research at UMH from **2011 to 2023**.

Editorial and peer-review activity includes statistical editing for *Public Health Nutrition* and reviewing in statistics, ecology and health sciences.
